reason: I'll burn the 50k free credit and maybe top up a small amount like 200k to test it on a side project, since VietQR is how I pay anyway. But at full official price I'm not moving my main usage off grey-market keys that cost me half.
objection: Grey-market credit is 40-60% cheaper; paying the full official rate plus whatever the bank FX spread is feels like overpaying for a convenience I already solved.
would_change_my_mind: A visible discount under the official price, or real reports in Facebook dev groups that grey-market keys got banned and this was the reliable fallback.
